% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpChess[position=8/8/3k4/8/3PK3/8/8/8,draggable-pieces]{}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/chess/chess.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-chess");
element1.setAttribute("position", "8/8/3k4/8/3PK3/8/8/8");
element1.setAttribute("draggable-pieces", "");
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Black to move
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpChess[fen=8/8/3k4/8/3PK3/8/8/8 b - - 0 1,orientation=black,draggable-pieces]{}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Pawn promotion
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpChess[fen=7k/P7/8/8/8/8/8/4K3 w - - 0 1,draggable-pieces]{}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Rook endgame
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpChess[fen=7k/8/5K2/8/8/8/8/R7 w - - 0 1,draggable-pieces]{}
\end{document}
